source.ref: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958, Sch. I Art. 36 (subst. by Mah. 32 of 2005 s.5(11) w.e.f. 7-5-2005; conveyance rates per Mah. 59 of 2017)
source.quoted_text: Sch I Art. 36 (both columns, IGR text): 'LEASE, including under lease or sub-lease and any agreement to let or sub-let or any renewal of lease — Where such lease purports to be — (i) for a period not exceeding five years — the same duty as is leviable on a conveyance under clause (a),(b) or (c) of article 25, on 10 per centum of the market value of the property; (ii) for a period exceeding five years but not exceeding ten years, with a renewal clause contingent or otherwise — ... on 25 per centum of the market value; (iii) for a period exceeding ten years but not exceeding twenty-nine years ... — ... on 50 per centum of the market value; (iv) for a period exceeding twenty-nine years or in perpetuity, or does not purport for any definite period ... — ... on 90 per centum of the market value.' Explanation I — premium/money advanced/security deposit, by whatever name, is treated as consideration passed on. Explanation II — a specified renewal period is treated as part of the present lease.

notes_for_reviewer: CONFIDENCE: HIGH (official IGR text). Duty = area-based Conveyance rate (Art 25) applied to a term-dependent PERCENTAGE of market value: ≤5y → 10%; >5≤10y → 25%; >10≤29y → 50%; >29y/perpetuity/no-definite → 90%. Boundaries in months: 60 / 120 / 348 (29y=348mo) / else. IMPORTANT: 'market_value' here must be the Explanation-I market value = property market value INCLUDING premium/deposit/security treated as consideration passed on — the questionnaire/Tier-2 must compute it; the cross-ref carries area_type through for the Art 25 rate. No perpetuity escalation needed (clause iv is the catch-all at 90%). Metro cess/LBT PENDING as for conveyance.
